system.description:
With a touch you seed a victim with a trace of your own vitae; later, at your call, that blood tears its way out of her from the inside.

First touch your target physically (which may require a Physical Challenge). Thereafter, at any point in the same scene or within the next hour — without needing to see her — you may spend one or more Willpower Traits and summon a Narrator. Each Willpower Trait spent forces the target to make one Static Physical Challenge against your Physical Traits, and each challenge she fails inflicts one level of lethal damage as her blood rips through her vessels and organs. You must declare all the Willpower you spend at once, and you cannot invoke the power on that subject again until you manage to touch her anew.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
